original: 強風のため電線が数箇所で切断された。

en.text: The strong wind cut the electric wires in several places.

indices: 強風 の 為(ため){ため} 電線[01] が 数(すう) 箇所 で(#2028980) 切断(せつだん)~ 為れる{された}

original: 手や足を切断した人はそれらがまだあるかのように感じ続ける。

en.text: People with amputated limbs continue to feel them as if they were still there.

original: 私は左足を切断してもらうほかなかった。

en.text: I had to have my left leg amputated.
I had no choice but to have my left leg amputated.
I had no choice except to have my left leg amputated.
